name: Linda Menkhorst-Elsinga
reason: Health rule: her site qtouch.nl (QTouch Trainingen, run with Yolande van Rosmalen) is condition-led: the Level 1 page promises to reduce or cure back pain and inflammation and realign bones, its testimonials describe pain relief after fractures, injuries and illness, and Quantum-Allergy (allergy testing and reset) is a core product; she describes herself as an allergy therapist since 2003. Owner may wish to reconsider, as she is the Dutch Quantum-Touch liaison and the site also offers all seven QT levels.
